description_en: Sends an SMS message from the platform
kebab_example: aliyun linkcard send-message --task-name '任务0912' --message-template-id 14 --message-variable-param '参数1_参数2_参数3' --message-send-time 1694401634 --msisdns 1411234123412 --api-product Linkcard --region cn-hangzhou
name: SendMessage

parameters.help_en: The custom task name. The name cannot contain special characters and can be up to 40 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 自定义任务名称，不能包含特殊字符，最长40个字符
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SMS template. You can view the template ID in the console
parameters.help_zh: 短信模版编号，可以在控制台查看
parameters.name: message_template_id

parameters.help_en: The replacement dynamic parameter for an SMS message, in the format {1}{2}
parameters.help_zh: 动态参数短信，替换的参数，格式{1}{2}
parameters.name: message_variable_param

parameters.help_en:
The timestamp, in seconds.

If the specified time is earlier than the current time, the message is sent immediately. If the specified time is later than the current time, the message is sent at the scheduled time.

The scheduled time cannot be more than one month from the current time
parameters.help_zh:
时间戳，单位：秒 。

当时间早于当前时间则立即发送，晚于当前时间为定时发送。

最晚不能超过一个月
parameters.name: message_send_time

parameters.help_en: The list of destination MSISDNs to which the SMS message is sent
parameters.name: msisdns
